source_message.text:
When adding images to the ontario drivers license book, you must inspect what you added instead of blindly copy-pasting it into the word doc. If an image contains spelling errors, re-generate that image before adding it to the MS word file. This means checking each image one by one.

step 1: Generate the image

step 2: Verify that it is correct

step 3: If there is no spelling error, add it to the MS word file

value_updates.spelling_error_action: Regenerate an image containing spelling errors before insertion.
value_updates.document_insertion_condition: Add an image to the document only after confirming that it has no spelling errors.
